availableCommands.name: context-gatherer
availableCommands.description: Investigates the codebase to answer a specific question about it. Deeply analyzes existing code by tracing execution paths, mapping architecture and abstraction layers, understanding patterns, and documenting dependencies, returning a thorough, direct written analysis that explains how the relevant code works and points to the specific files and lines involved. Use it to understand code before you change it: before designing or implementing a change to code you don't already fully understand, start with context-gatherer so your edits are grounded in how the code actually works. When a task requires understanding code you don't already know, dispatch context-gatherer to do that exploration before running your own searches or reads. Rules: 1. Provide a clear, specific prompt that includes your intent: a detailed task description of the context you need and what you're trying to accomplish. 2. The subagent explores the codebase and returns an analysis of your query 3. Trust the returned results. You may still inspect additional code yourself when you need context beyond what was returned. 4. Reuse existing context-gatherer output for related follow-up questions; do not re-invoke on the same question with different phrasing. 5. For multiple distinct questions, dispatch several context-gatherers in parallel, each targeting a different aspect of the codebase.

content.oldText: # Circuit Séance — Implementation Tasks **Feature:** Circuit Séance MVP **Version:** 1.1 **Date:** 2026-11-02 --- ## MVP Core Path The following tasks form the minimum viable demo (judge sees a live waveform in ≤ 10 s with no API key): > **Scaffold** (1) → **i18n** (2) → **Examples** (3) → **Shell** (4) → **Parser/Validator** (5–6) → **Worker + Sim** (7–8) → **Scope** (9–10) → **Controls** (11) → **Capture** (12) → **OpenAI-compat adapter** (13) → **Response parser** (14) → **Transcribe panel** (15) → **Offline spirit** (16) → **Spirit panel** (17) → **Wiring** (18) → **Unit tests** (22–24) → **Demo mode** (28) → **Build verify** (27) CodeMirror 6 (`spice-mode.ts`, full CM6 editor) and the Anthropic adapter are **stretch goals** — implement them after the core path is green. Tasks are ordered so the app is demoable as early as possible. Sub-tasks within each group are sequenced by dependency. --- ## Phase 1 — Project Scaffold - [x] 1. Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling _Requirements: 1.1_ - [x] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly. - [x] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option. - [x] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`. - [x] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check. - [x] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works. - [x] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder. - [x] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`. - [x] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper. - [x] 2. Set up i18n string system _Requirements: 1.2_ - [x] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels. - [x] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values. - [x] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map. - [x] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it. --- ## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout - [x] 3. Add bundled example netlists _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_ - [x] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive. - [x] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import). - [x] 4. Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [ ] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling _Requirements: 1.1_ - [x] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly. - [x] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option. - [x] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`. - [x] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check. - [x] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works. - [x] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder. - [x] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`. - [x] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper. - [x] 2. Set up i18n string system _Requirements: 1.2_ - [x] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels. - [x] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values. - [x] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map. - [x] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it. --- ## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout - [x] 3. Add bundled example netlists _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_ - [x] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive. - [x] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import). - [x] 4. Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [x] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. _SettingsDialog.tsx; key kept only in localStorage by owner decision_ - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

content.oldText: # Circuit Séance — Implementation Tasks **Feature:** Circuit Séance MVP **Version:** 1.1 **Date:** 2026-11-02 --- ## MVP Core Path The following tasks form the minimum viable demo (judge sees a live waveform in ≤ 10 s with no API key): > **Scaffold** (1) → **i18n** (2) → **Examples** (3) → **Shell** (4) → **Parser/Validator** (5–6) → **Worker + Sim** (7–8) → **Scope** (9–10) → **Controls** (11) → **Capture** (12) → **OpenAI-compat adapter** (13) → **Response parser** (14) → **Transcribe panel** (15) → **Offline spirit** (16) → **Spirit panel** (17) → **Wiring** (18) → **Unit tests** (22–24) → **Demo mode** (28) → **Build verify** (27) CodeMirror 6 (`spice-mode.ts`, full CM6 editor) and the Anthropic adapter are **stretch goals** — implement them after the core path is green. Tasks are ordered so the app is demoable as early as possible. Sub-tasks within each group are sequenced by dependency. --- ## Phase 1 — Project Scaffold - [x] 1. Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling _Requirements: 1.1_ - [x] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly. - [x] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option. - [x] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`. - [x] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check. - [x] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works. - [x] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder. - [x] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`. - [x] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper. - [x] 2. Set up i18n string system _Requirements: 1.2_ - [x] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels. - [x] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values. - [x] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map. - [x] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it. --- ## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout - [x] 3. Add bundled example netlists _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_ - [x] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive. - [x] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import). - [x] 4. Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [x] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. _SettingsDialog.tsx; key kept only in localStorage by owner decision_ - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling _Requirements: 1.1_ - [x] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly. - [x] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option. - [x] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`. - [x] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check. - [x] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works. - [x] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder. - [x] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`. - [x] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper. - [x] 2. Set up i18n string system _Requirements: 1.2_ - [x] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels. - [x] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values. - [x] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map. - [x] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it. --- ## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout - [x] 3. Add bundled example netlists _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_ - [x] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive. - [x] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import). - [x] 4. Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [x] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. _SettingsDialog.tsx; key kept only in localStorage by owner decision_ - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Set up i18n string system _Requirements: 1.2_ - [x] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels. - [x] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values. - [x] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map. - [x] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it. --- ## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout - [x] 3. Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [x] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. _SettingsDialog.tsx; key kept only in localStorage by owner decision_ - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling _Requirements: 1.1_ - [x] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly. - [x] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option. - [x] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`. - [x] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check. - [x] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works. - [x] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder. - [x] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`. - [x] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper. - [x] 2. Set up i18n string system _Requirements: 1.2_ - [x] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels. - [x] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values. - [x] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map. - [x] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it. --- ## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout - [x] 3. Add bundled example netlists _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_ - [x] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive. - [x] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import). - [x] 4. Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [x] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. _SettingsDialog.tsx; key kept only in localStorage by owner decision_ - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling _Requirements: 1.1_ - [x] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly. - [x] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option. - [x] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`. - [x] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check. - [x] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works. - [x] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder. - [x] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`. - [x] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper. - [x] 2. Set up i18n string system _Requirements: 1.2_ - [x] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels. - [x] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values. - [x] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map. - [x] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it. --- ## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout - [x] 3. Add bundled example netlists _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_ - [x] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive. - [x] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import). - [x] 4. Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [x] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. _SettingsDialog.tsx; key kept only in localStorage by owner decision_ - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Initialise the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with all tooling _Requirements: 1.1_ - [x] 1.1 Run `npm create vite@latest circuit-seance -- --template react-ts` and commit the baseline; verify `npm run dev` starts cleanly. - [x] 1.2 Configure TypeScript `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`; add `@/` path alias in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`; expose `VITE_BASE_URL` env variable as the Vite `base` option. - [x] 1.3 Install and configure ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/recommended` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`; add `eslint.config.js`. - [x] 1.4 Install and configure Prettier; add `prettier.config.js` and `.prettierignore`; wire `npm run lint` to run both ESLint and Prettier check. - [x] 1.5 Install Vitest and configure `npm test` (single-run mode); add a trivial passing test to confirm the runner works. - [x] 1.6 Create the full `src/` folder skeleton: `app/`, `features/{capture,transcribe,netlist,simulate,scope,spirit,demo,haunted}/`, `lib/llm/`, `examples/`, `shared/`; add an `index.ts` stub barrel in each feature folder. - [x] 1.7 Create `src/shared/types.ts` with the core interfaces: `SimResult`, `AnalysisType`, `CompactSummary`, `AppSettings`, `LLMConfig`, `LLMError`, `SampleAsset`, `DemoStep`, `HomeworkCheckResult`. - [x] 1.8 Create `src/shared/utils.ts` with at minimum a `generateId()` (nanoid-style) helper. - [x] 2. Set up i18n string system _Requirements: 1.2_ - [x] 2.1 Create `src/app/i18n/en.ts` with all English UI strings as a typed `Record` export; cover: nav labels, button labels, error messages, loading states, settings labels, scope labels, spirit labels, demo badge text, homework check labels. - [x] 2.2 Create `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` mirroring every key from `en.ts` with Simplified Chinese values. - [x] 2.3 Create `src/app/i18n/index.ts` exporting a `useTranslation()` hook that reads `AppSettings.language` from a React context and returns the active locale map. - [x] 2.4 Create a `LanguageContext` (in `src/app/`) that provides the language state and a toggle function; wrap `App.tsx` in it. --- ## Phase 2 — Bundled Examples & Shell Layout - [x] 3. Add bundled example netlists _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_ - [x] 3.1 Write `src/examples/rc-lowpass.net` — RC low-pass filter with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.2 Write `src/examples/rl.net` — RL circuit with `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.3 Write `src/examples/rlc-ringing.net` — RLC series with under-damped ringing, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.4 Write `src/examples/diode-rectifier.net` — half-wave diode rectifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.5 Write `src/examples/bjt-common-emitter.net` — BJT common-emitter amplifier, `.tran` directive. - [x] 3.6 Write `src/examples/opamp-inverting.net` — op-amp inverting amplifier, `.ac` directive. - [x] 3.7 Create `src/examples/index.ts` exporting an `EXAMPLE_CIRCUITS` array of `{ id, label, labelZh, net: string }` where `net` is the bundled netlist imported as a string (`?raw` Vite import). - [x] 4. Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [x] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. _SettingsDialog.tsx; key kept only in localStorage by owner decision_ - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `

Build the application shell layout _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 10.1_ - [x] 4.1 Create `src/app/App.tsx` with the two-panel layout: left panel (capture + netlist) and right panel (scope + spirit); use CSS Grid or Flexbox. - [x] 4.2 Add the top toolbar with: app title ("Circuit Séance / 电路招魂"), language toggle button (EN / 中文), and settings icon button. - [x] 4.3 Add a status bar at the bottom showing current simulation status; wire it to an `aria-live="polite"` region so screen readers announce status changes. - [x] 4.4 Implement responsive breakpoint: `< 1024 px` collapses to single-column stacked layout. - [x] 4.5 Add CSS custom properties for the CRT colour palette: background `#0a0f0a`, phosphor greens, graticule grey; import a monospace web font (e.g. `Share Tech Mono`) for the scope labels. - [x] 4.6 Create a `SettingsPanel` component (modal or drawer) with: provider preset selector (Qwen-VL default, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Anthropic stretch), API key field (masked), base URL field (editable, pre-filled by preset), model field (editable, pre-filled by preset), storage mode toggle ("Remember across sessions"), close button. _SettingsDialog.tsx; key kept only in localStorage by owner decision_ - [x] 4.7 Wire settings state to `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` per `AppSettings.storageMode`; default storage is `sessionStorage`; never store the key in a React state tree that could be serialised to DevTools. --- ## Phase 3 — Netlist Editor - [x] 5. Implement the SPICE netlist parser _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3_ - [x] 5.1 **MVP editor:** create `src/features/netlist/NetlistEditor.tsx` as a styled `
